content.content: G500 has a range of 500km on one tank, it is electric car range. Each tank (100L) will cost you ......The first things that will fail on these are turning signals, they will leak through screws on top ( design genius). The door locks will freeze solid in the Winter (lol, military car). The front frame around windscreen is full of rust as water stays under rubber gasket = 360 rust guaranteed. Next things will leak around 80K km are 1. steering box 2. left and right portal axels. 3. front struts 4. sunroof will not open and 100% rust around gaskets. If you get V6 diesel you going to have better fuel economy but emission system will give you problems around 100K kilometers. Steering is special, this truck will not travel in straight line ever. Maintenance on these is heavy. It takes so much oil even if I do oil change myself it will cost me around 300 Eur. At MB 800Eur. Parts and repairs are a bear. Very few mechanics know how to swap parts or change gaskets on these and those who know will charge you for it. I am buying new G-450 next year but I am a glutton for punishment...
